name: posture-api
description: Stateless HTTP API: front and side posture photos in, a Chinese training report or retake guidance out.

scripts.test: npm run build -w posture-core && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w posture-core && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.start: npm run build -w posture-core && node --import tsx src/main.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run build -w posture-core && node --import tsx scripts/smoke.ts
